arguments.sql_query: SELECT TOP 20 concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept FROM omop.concept WHERE LOWER(concept_name) = 'rheumatoid arthritis' AND domain_id = 'Condition' ORDER BY CASE WHEN standard_concept = 'S' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, vocabulary_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS ra_patients_receiving_adalimumab
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor da
  ON de.drug_concept_id = da.descendant_concept_id
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
  ON co.person_id = de.person_id
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
  ON co.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
WHERE da.ancestor_concept_id = 1119119  -- adalimumab RxNorm ingredient
  AND ca.ancestor_concept_id = 80809    -- rheumatoid arthritis SNOMED

content.text:
A commonly used anti-TNF therapy is **adalimumab**.

Using the OMOP `drug_exposure` table, counting distinct patients with an RA condition descendant of SNOMED **Rheumatoid arthritis** (`concept_id=80809`) and an adalimumab drug descendant of RxNorm ingredient **adalimumab** (`concept_id=1119119`):

**925 RA patients received adalimumab.**
